title: Deep Learning and Machine Learning - Natural Language Processing: From Theory to Application

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the distribution and sequence length of subword tokens for names from different ethnic groups during tokenization (e.g., comparing tokenization splits for names like 'John', 'Nguyen', and 'Xiaoling'), as well as using bias detection tools to evaluate generated text for stereotypes.

Measuring the distribution of subword tokens across gendered groups during tokenization, and using bias detection tools to evaluate generated text for biased associations, such as linking specific professions or roles to gendered pronouns and names.
